fit_note: the WALK-FORWARD run in the receipt is how the method was judged; this table is what the product uses tomorrow and may legitimately use every observation that has already resolved. They are different questions and must not be read as one.
vol_estimator: trailing 12 MONTHLY CRSP returns, annualised by sqrt(12), shifted one month. The LIVE path buckets on 252 DAILY yfinance returns, which is a different estimator: monthly sampling rarely puts a mega-cap above the 45% vol_high line that daily sampling clears easily. `price_target.resolve_cohort` falls back to a coarser bucket and NAMES the level rather than pretending the exact one was fitted.
